This beautiful collection invites children to step into a magical world where every day holds a lesson and a journey. Get ready to explore alongside Twilight Sparkle and her dearest friends as they embark on five unforgettable adventures, covering everything from the towering skyscrapers of Manehattan to the whimsical depths of the Free Spirit Forest.
